scope: Reactive environment follow-through, grounded reading signs and ambient scheduling. Existing raster assets and native gameplay collision are preserved.

notes: World-unit transforms survive nonuniform room scale; four painted poses and maximum flex reserve real silhouette space.
Changed/disabled support rebuilds growth; old springs reset and retire safely without stale member-snapshot pointers.
180 plants per room cap is unchanged; current contacts take priority over distant settling plants.
Upward jumps brush hanging roots/cloth; grounded grass still responds to passing/landing.
Visible fall corridors are considered even when the emitter is above the camera.
Checkpoint state setters refresh flame/tint immediately outside animation selection; camera refresh does not reset retained flame poses.
Category reservations share the existing total cap; no extra per-prop callbacks were added.
Sources use registered opaque root tips, including cropped atlas offsets and current bend.
A drop snapshots its emitter on release, then falls independently from later root motion.
Full root-swing corridors must fit their real landing and clear walls/devices; 31 unsafe legacy sites are omitted.
Ash remains dry. Source PNG pixels are unchanged.
Fit the whole painted pedestal, not its reading anchor (the old artwork was offset by 42 world units).
Native Gallery DEPTH 5 edge-overhang and Hearth provider ground-contact cases are covered.
Unsupported or ceiling-blocked sites retain their clue and reading access without an invented floating pedestal or transfer to another tier.
Restoring support restores the pedestal; reentry is idempotent; physical task-board art is retained.
First-time finish revalidates signs after final portal, ceiling-vault and relief geometry.
Native 1280x720 renderer; player settles on actual collision before each view.
Lamp states are captured with zero active ambient slots and no direct call to its animator.
Preview only: room simulation and enemy/area collision are frozen to isolate scenery. This is not a normal-health combat playthrough.

editor_import.notes: Class registration and asset import succeeded; sandbox denied saving global editor settings outside the workspace.

limitations: Focused regression selection, not the complete smoke suite, continuous full campaign, exported-build certification or device/FPS benchmark.
Windows root-certificate warning remains; native rendering reports sandbox shader-cache write denials, not script/shader compilation failures.
Mixed ambient category counts are synthetic fixture measurements, not a claimed count of all previously starved lamps in the live world.
No new raster generation in this corrective pass; existing art is reused. Full-game visual completion is not claimed.
Run folders are ignored local artifacts; tests, this report and native screenshots are versioned.
